text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lately, Fine Motion has been drawing 
public attention due to her pedigree and 
remarkable strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting with her friend Daiwa Scarlet, 
those around her express their concern, 
but she responds casually and cheerily.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, even the shy Zenno Rob Roy came 
over to talk to Fine Motion. Watching the 
scene unfold, the Trainer had a thought.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She isn't just strong and noble. She 
possesses a mysterious power that 
captivates anyone and everyone.
